freezewhenenteringworld.title.freeze_tog: Toggles the persistent TOML config 'freezeOnWorldEnter' (default OFF) and saves it. When ON, entering any world freezes it immediately; the state is remembered after a restart. Dedicated servers can set the same value in config/freezewhenenteringworld-common.toml.
message.freezewhenenteringworld.entity_r: Could not remove %s. Turn on dangerous removal mode (Shift+right-click air/block) and try again.
Dangerous removal mode: ON. Forced replacement may leave other code holding a stale entity reference.
Players cannot be removed with this wand.
